user.title: Add a chore
user.description: Create a new chore. Each chore becomes a device that transitions between done and overdue on the configured interval.

data_description.name: A short label for this chore, e.g. Bins or Vacuuming.

corrupt_last_completed.title: Last Completed date reset for "{name}"
corrupt_last_completed.description: The Last Completed date for chore "{name}" contained a malformed value and was reset. If the issue persists, delete and recreate the chore.

corrupt_snooze_until.title: Snooze Expiry reset for "{name}"
corrupt_snooze_until.description: The Snooze Expiry for chore "{name}" contained a malformed value and was reset. If the issue persists, delete and recreate the chore.

corrupt_unrecoverable_config.title: Chore configuration error for "{name}"
corrupt_unrecoverable_config.description: The chore entry could not load due to an invalid configuration value: {error}. Delete and recreate the chore to fix this.

completed_at_in_future.message: Completed at must not be in the future

snooze_until_in_past.message: Snooze until must be a future date and time

default_snooze_value_out_of_range.message: Default snooze value must be between 1 and 365

invalid_snooze_unit.message: Invalid snooze unit "{option}"; must be one of: minutes, hours, days, weeks

complete.name: Complete chore
complete.description: Mark a chore as completed, returning it to "done". Optionally supply completed_at to record a specific past datetime; omit to default to now.

completed_at.name: Completed at
completed_at.description: The datetime the chore was completed. Must not be in the future. Defaults to now if omitted.

snooze.name: Snooze chore
snooze.description: Snooze a chore for a given duration, suppressing overdue transitions until then. Provide a value and a unit (minutes, hours, days, or weeks).

value.name: Value
value.description: Number of units to snooze from now.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Time unit for the snooze duration (minutes, hours, days, or weeks).

unsnooze.name: Unsnooze chore
unsnooze.description: Cancel an active snooze, returning the chore to "done" or "overdue".
